_comment: Level playing field: every approach goes through the same SPY/TLT pipeline. Only the source of the raw signal differs. Tune prior_weights on development months only, then freeze before the protected window. JEV and COMMITTEE are the one-month answers (level horizon); JEV_12M and COMMITTEE_12M are the original 12-month answers, kept as a check.

sources.macro_panel: stage2 run spec dev v4 (8 surprise z-scores, the deterministic model's inputs)

_covariance_note: sample = plain 36-month sample covariance (ddof=1). With two assets Ledoit-Wolf shrinks 40-100% toward equal variances and zero correlation, which erases the SPY-TLT negative correlation; 'ledoit_wolf' is kept as an option.
_causal_rag_note: CAUSAL_RAG is exploratory (stand-in model, reliability gates failed) and is kept out of the primary Holm family; its IEF signals stand in for TLT.
